title: 1988 AMC 8 Problem 5
statement: If \(\angle CBD\) is a right angle, then this protractor indicates that the measure of \(\angle ABC\) is approximately

solutions.text:
Reading the protractor, ray \(BA\) is at about \(20^\circ\) and ray \(BD\) is at about \(160^\circ.\)

Because \(\angle CBD\) is a right angle, ray \(BC\) is at \(160^\circ - 90^\circ = 70^\circ.\)

Therefore \(\angle ABC = 70^\circ - 20^\circ = 50^\circ.\)

Thus, the correct answer is C .
hints: On the protractor, ray \(BA\) reads about \(20^\circ\) and ray \(BD\) reads about \(160^\circ\)
Since \(\angle CBD = 90^\circ\) and \(BD\) reads \(160^\circ,\) ray \(BC\) reads \(160^\circ - 90^\circ.\) Then \(\angle ABC\) is the difference between the readings of \(BC\) and \(BA.\)
